Author: qx
Name: Doman Mahjong Solver
Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Changelog: v0.1.6.3: Fixes a regression introduced by v0.1.6.2. That release made DispatchCallOption infer the button to click from the option index (option 0 meaning "Tsumo") so the state-6 self-declare popup would no longer press a hand tile instead of the Tsumo button. The inference was wrong: a Riichi-confirm at option 0 was also routed to the label path, so it stopped dispatching and logged HookFailed every time - the bot declared riichi, then failed to confirm it, leaving the declaration popup open. Field log 2026-10-12 06:22 shows auto-riichi-confirm[opt=0] -> HookFailed where v0.1.6.1 and earlier returned Ok. DispatchCallOption now takes the button label explicitly as a second parameter; only a self-declared tsumo passes "Tsumo", and every other action (Riichi-confirm, Pass, Pon, Chi, Kan, Ron) keeps its positional dispatch untouched. Unknown labels are rejected rather than guessed. The v0.1.6.2 self-declare fix itself is unchanged and still applies. Verified by build (0 errors/0 warnings) and 712 passing tests.
